text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's summer camp. I want to use this chance to prepare Agnes Tachyon for her upcoming G1—the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But somehow, I find myself doing workouts at her request instead.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: 141, 142… You're almost there! Put some back into it, guinea pig!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite it being summer camp, I'm subject to her experimentation from dusk until dawn, like always.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …149, and 150! Okay, stop! Now let me measure your endorphin secretion levels.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At that moment, several reporters come running on over.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: You are Agnes Tachyon, correct?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …That is correct. I'm sorry, but can you come back later? I'm in the middle of an experiment right now…

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Can you tell me more about why you didn't enter the Gekkei Hai?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just before summer camp started, Agnes Tachyon decided to withdraw from the Gekkei Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Originally a special race meant to stimulate excitement within the racing community, the news spread like wildfire.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There were even voices criticizing her lack of commitment.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Dear me. I knew I saw some unfamiliar faces sneak into the summer camp…
choice_data_list: You need to go through the academy first if you want to have an interview.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I push my way through the throng of reporters, but find the microphones previously pointed at her suddenly all facing me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, do you understand the problems caused by your racer's sudden cancellation?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Although she is a student of Tracen Academy, there have been rumors claiming that she lacked motivation even for her debut race.
choice_data_list: As I just said, you will have to make a formal application in order to conduct an interview…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: They're much closer to a guinea pig than an actual trainer. So, it would be much more constructive if you directed your questions at me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: They're much closer to a guinea pig than an actual trainer. So, it would be much more constructive if you directed your questions at me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once again, the microphones surround Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: So, as a highly talented Umamusume, what are your thoughts regarding the future of the Umamusume world and your responsibilities to it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Unlike the student council president, I am down-to-earth.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Nevertheless, if that is your question, then let me pose another.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Suppose that you succeeded in eliciting a response from me. Would my answer really contribute to the future of Umamusume? Can you explain to me the significance of the time spent on this?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I can't stand such trivial usage of time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon turns away from the flinching reporters.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Should we get going, guinea pig? It appears today is not a day fit for experimentation.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Tch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't help but feel a nagging uneasiness at the reporters' visible frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Troublemaker in the Umamusume Community, Agnes Tachyon. Heh-heh-heh, what an amusing provocation!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Forgoing her summer camp training for recreational experimentation, this Umamusume exposes her trainer, whom she refers to as 'guinea pig,' to her cruel instruments of science…"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "With an outlook of indifference and apathy to the future of Umamusume…"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This is incredible! Their malice is apparent, but they didn't fabricate a single word!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems in high spirits, but if this situation goes on, her professional career might be negatively impacted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not to mention, I haven't even heard her reason for backing out of the Gekkei Hai either.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Is something the matter, Trainer? Why the long face?
choice_data_list: Why did you withdraw from the race?
Why did you withdraw from the race?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh? Are you still curious about that?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now that I think about it, you really don't know why, do you? I suppose that does hinder your duties as my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sadly, there are unavoidable circumstances at hand preventing me from telling you more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As expected, she has no intention of sharing her reasons.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But as it stands, I won't be able to protect her when the time comes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Worried, you say. Hmm… That's right, you are quite the worrywart.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm… Let me preface this by saying that this withholding of information is a conscious decision.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I dropped out of the Gekkei Hai for a good reason.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she tells me this, she looks me square in the eyes. Her tone is soft but her expression is unusually honest.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If everything goes well, we'll have a nice long talk about it. I can promise you that.
choice_data_list: (There's so much I'm in the dark about…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Contrary to what the article claimed, I know she's not indifferent. She has some kind of plan in mind, I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I nod in silent agreement, to which she replies with a small smile of relief.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Mhm, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: All right. With that out of the way, let's hit the beach! Nice blue skies and not too hot—it's the perfect day to conduct experiments!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ha-ha-ha! Don't be shy! With luck, we'll manage to finish up by the end of the day!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: To tell you the truth, Plan A has finally moved on to the hypothesis testing phase!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'll let you pick for today! Would you like to do strength training or beach running?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Splendid choice! In that case, count the reps for me, will you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh, of course. You're still out of commission from earlier testing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: To verify the hypothesis for Plan A, my own body will be required.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Do you have the tally counter in hand? Then let's start!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For the first time in a while, I spend the day watching over her training.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff! Heh-heh, heh-heh-heh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes! That felt great! Hardly a problem! At last, success!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After going beyond her original goal, her body gives out onto the sand.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …Success!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look over at Agnes Tachyon and see a dazzling smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Okay. I'll be running laps around the beach, so record my times!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Of course. You're still out of commission from earlier testing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: To verify the hypothesis for Plan A, my own body will be required.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Do you have the stopwatch in hand? Then let's start!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Without wasting a second, she takes off into a run. The horizon quickly swallows up her figure.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, hahahaha! Yes! It is within grasp, finally!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she returns, her eyes are ablaze with excitement. I haven't seen her this fired up in a while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She catches her breath as her body gives out and lands on the sand.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …Success!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look over at Agnes Tachyon and see her grinning from ear to ear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, she formally announces her plan to run in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The heated criticism directed at her frivolous attitude is certainly no laughing matter, but…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm… There really were no false statements in the articles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I thought, she's paying no heed to the naysayers.
